framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the tall frame
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright midday sunlight
character: shaggy cream goat with amber slit eyes and curled horns, a tax folder gripped in its teeth, fills two thirds of the frame
props: a bulging tax folder shedding forms; a boom microphone at its muzzle; the reporter's hands and striped sleeve at the lens; a wooden fence rail that breaks; a clipboard; a fresh stack of forms

motion_rule: drives at the lens every window and never holds a pose, not even the last; new shot size every window, camera always moving
